summary: Bounded architecture-plus-integration phase (149O.20L.7O.3M) for the human-selected Candidate A priority (rollback readiness/evidence automatic generation and consumption). Re-derived the current rollback architecture directly from src/pcae/core/agent.py::build_rollback_execution and src/pcae/commands/agent.py::run_rollback at phase-entry HEAD, not from inherited 3E/3F/3I summaries. Central finding: the 'prepare evidence -> consume internally -> stop if invalid -> Permission Broker -> effect' automation this phase's governing brief describes was already the exact production behavior of a real (non---dry-run) pcae rollback --per-id X invocation, released in v0.4.1 (149O.20L.7O.3F) -- file_plan/divergence_check are computed unconditionally regardless of the --dry-run flag and already gate the divergence short-circuit before either authority gate. This corrects 3I's own framing of 'current manual choreography' (which characterized a manual dry-run-then-re-invoke pattern as required; re-derivation shows it was always optional/advisory). Exhaustive re-grep confirmed no existing typed readiness concept exists anywhere in src/pcae; none was invented. A materially larger candidate -- proactively persisting a readiness artifact at pcae promote-completion time -- was considered and explicitly rejected as requiring a new freshness/identity contract this phase has no authority to invent (staleness hazard across the promotion-to-rollback time gap); per the governing brief's Section 26/48 stop rule, that candidate was not implemented. This phase's one narrow, additive production change: surfaced the already-computed, already-consumed, already-persisted evidence (file_plan/divergence_check) directly in every terminal result build_rollback_execution returns (four return sites: divergence_conflict, the HATP_MANDATORY gate-denial, the default-path Permission Broker denial, and the final success/partial/failed result) and in pcae rollback's human-readable CLI output -- closing the gap where an operator previously needed a second command (pcae rollback-execution show) to see evidence that had already gated their own command's outcome. Two production files changed, both purely additive (git diff --stat confirms zero deletions): src/pcae/core/agent.py (+23 lines) and src/pcae/commands/agent.py (+13 lines). No new type, schema, class, function, or persisted artifact was added; no gating, ordering, or authority semantics changed. New 18-test focused suite (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_3m_rollback_readiness_evidence_automatic_consumption.py), all passing, covering: preparation-is-already-automatic, evidence surfacing and its match to the persisted RollbackExecutionRecord, evidence non-authority (clean evidence plus a forced DENY still blocks), Permission Broker invocation-count and sequencing, HATP isolation, no-new-readiness-type and single-production-caller structural guards, read-only side-effect verification, manual --dry-run compatibility, restart/idempotency, and runtime independence. Rollback regressions (tests/test_ag5_hatp_mandatory_consumption.py, tests/test_hatp_cli_migration.py, tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_3f_rollback_permission_broker_default_path.py, tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_3f_1_independent_rollback_permission_verification.py, tests/test_agent.py -k rollback): all passed, 0 attributable failures. tests/test_phase_149o_18d_ag5_mandatory_consumption_integration.py: 5 pre-existing frozen-diff self-check failures, independently re-confirmed identical before this phase's diff via git stash push -u/re-run/pop. Permission Broker/mutation-permission regressions (8 files, 562 tests combined with this phase's own suite and the 3F/3F.1 rollback-PB suites): 0 failures. v0.4.2 RI-attachment regression smoke (46 tests): 0 failures, no source overlap. Fast Green attribution (pcae phase fast-green-attribution --phase-id 149O.20L.7O.3M --json, baseline 7b193145, candidate e632a2df): status PASS, raw_failed_count 339, raw_errors_count 9, attributable_failures 0 (empty list), 347 excluded as pre-existing baseline failures, 0 excluded_environment_failures, 1 expected_phase_artifact (the self-referential local-only push-state tripwire, expected pre-push). An initial run of this tool produced a corrupted/concatenated output file from two concurrent invocations racing on the same output path (author error, not a tool defect); the run was repeated cleanly and its result is what is recorded here. No Candidate B (runtime preflight) or true RI-backed Advisory reasoning work was implemented this phase. Runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable, independently reverified unchanged at phase entry and phase close. Version unchanged (0.4.2). No tag, release, or PyPI publication performed. Article remains STOPPED; ~/repos/pcae-deepseek-research untouched, out of scope, not inspected.
